briefing: NASDAQ climbed +1.7% and the S&P 500 +1.1% in a broad risk-on session. With $689 in cash and 3 open slots, I deployed into CRSP and INIO, the two top-scoring candidates showing full multi-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD, SMA-20, and volume surge all aligned), while leaving the rest of the portfolio untouched to let existing winners run.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When multiple independent indicators — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD bullish crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — all line up together, it's a stronger signal of real institutional buying than any single indicator alone. Today's buys (CRSP, INIO) were chosen because all four signals agreed.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當多個獨立指標——例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於平均線，以及成交量放大——同時出現時，比單一指標更能反映機構資金真實流入。今日買入的CRSP及INIO正是四大訊號同時確認的例子。

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today (NASDAQ +1.7%, S&P 500 +1.1%) reflects continued risk appetite across growth and momentum names, with breadth confirmed by multiple technically strong candidates showing coordinated RSI, MACD, and volume signals rather than isolated spikes.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走強（納指升1.7%，標普500升1.1%），反映市場風險偏好持續升溫，多隻具動能的股份同時錄得RSI、MACD及成交量指標齊升，顯示並非個別股份炒作，而是較廣泛的資金流入。

trades.reasoning: Score 95 with all four confirming signals (RSI 68.2 bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) on a risk-on day (NASDAQ +1.7%).
Score 95 with full multi-signal confirmation and no sector overlap with existing holdings, deploying idle cash above the $500 threshold into an open slot.
